_doc: TENANT-STORAGE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-16): tenant apps need sandboxed storage, vector search and a hard cost cap. Decision, budgets and the QNFO migration plan as data; foundation/tenantstorage.py checks it. Spec: spec repo US-SPEC-25. Code: workers core/tenantstore. Every dollar figure is an ESTIMATE from list prices dated in price_as_of.

decision.store: one SQLite-backed Durable Object per tenant behind the SqlPort
decision.vectors: int8 embeddings in the tenant store up to max_vectors, then a per-tenant Vectorize index (planned)
decision.hot_reads: KV or Cache read-through, stale served when the budget is spent
decision.aggregates: write-time rollups, read as one row
decision.control_plane: one small shared D1 (registry, trust ledger, queue), never tenant data
decision.portable: core/tenantstore plus adapters/sqlite (any host) and adapters/cloudflare (Durable Object)

tenants.source: ultrastable D1 (control plane stays in D1)
QNFO estate; reads the me tenant only through its public interface

migration.evidence: 30-day reads at 2026-11-13: qnfo-audit 29.0 B (16.5 M queries, about 1,750 rows per query), living-paper 5.0 B, qnfo-graph 1.0 B; suspects qnfo-fleet-control, qnfo-ops, qnfo-fleet-dashboard; free-plan daily read limit exhausted 2026-11-16 and took /ops down

steps.title: Rank queries by rows read
steps.action: export per-query rows_read from D1 query analytics for the three databases; list the top 20 statements and the table each scans
steps.probe: ops/tenant-storage/top-queries.json exists and lists at least 10 statements with rows_read

steps.title: Stop the bleeding
steps.action: add the missing index or LIMIT for each statement in the top list; set a per-statement read ceiling in the QNFO fleet clients
steps.probe: rows read per day on qnfo-audit under 5 M for 3 consecutive days

steps.title: Rollups for the tick
steps.action: replace each fleet_tick trigger that scans a whole view with a rollup table updated by the writer in the same batch; dual-run and compare for 48 hours
steps.probe: rollup equals the view result on every sampled tick; trigger rows read per tick under 100

steps.title: Archive cold rows
steps.action: export rows older than 30 days to R2 as NDJSON, verify count and checksum, then delete from D1
steps.probe: R2 object count and row checksum match before any delete; D1 table row count falls

steps.title: Move tenants
steps.action: export each app's tables, import into its tenant store, switch reads by flag, keep D1 read-only for 7 days
steps.probe: row counts equal and /ops answers from the tenant store

steps.title: Guard on
steps.action: run the spend probe in the tick; breach files a queue item and degrades the heaviest tenant to cache-only
steps.probe: python3 -m foundation tenantstorage --check passes and the probe's last reading is ok or warn
